changes.old: The Dynamic Key Exchange (DKE) Service is an optional service that enables clients to change Data Encryption Standard (DES) cryptographic keys with VisaNet through the use of online 0800 and 0810 messages. For a comprehensive description of the D KE Service, refer to V.I.P. System Services. The following fields in the 0800 request are used for a DKE Service key exchange request: Field 11 11—System Trace Audit Number Field 33 33—Forwarding Institution Identification Code Field 39 39—Response Code Field 48, U sage 14 14—Dynamic Key Exchange Working Key Check Value Field 52 52—Personal Identification Number (PIN) Data Field 53 53—Security-Related Control Information Field 63.1—Net work ID Code Field 70 70—Network Management Information Code Field 10 105—Double-Length DES Key (Triple DES) Field 11 110—Encryption Data (TLV Format) Clients use 0800 requests to request and to deliver new working keys for PIN encryption; clients use 0810 responses to acknowledge their receipt. The 0800 message initiator, which can be a participating acquirer or issuer, or V.I.P., assigns the trace number (in field 11). Clients must return the trace number unchanged in the 0810 response. If a request must be re-sent, its trace number comes from the original request. The message originator must indicate which key is to be changed in Field 53 53—Security-Related Control Information. Acquirers can begin using the new key after the 0810 response is sent to V.I.P. For acquirers supporting a single working key, V.I.P. has the option of processing messages with the new key or with the old key for five minutes. V.I.P. continues sending messages with the old key until it receives the 0810 response. Therefore, single-key issuers must keep a copy of the old key until V.I.P. begins using the new one.
